result:
F-DG3-170 is fixed. The inherited-approval badge now wraps inside its card on the Gates list and inside its row on the gate view, in English and Arabic. Its full text, including "(does not approve this gate)" / "(لا يعتمد هذه البوابة)", is visible at every width tested. All required checks passed, and the changes are left uncommitted for you to integrate.

**The fix:**
- **CSS:** a new opt-in class, `status-chip--wrap`, lets the text wrap and caps the badge at its container's width. It uses logical properties so it works in RTL, keeps the icon at the start of the first line, and uses a smaller corner radius so multi-line text isn't clipped at the corners. The global `.status-chip` no-wrap rule is unchanged.
- **Badge:** in `GatesPage.tsx` it uses the new class and puts its text in a `<span>`. It is still neutral (grey chip, info icon, never the approved colour or check icon), and its text and data attributes are unchanged. I didn't need to touch `GateDetailPage.tsx` or the translations.
- **Unit test:** `inherited-approval.test.tsx` also checks for the new class. All existing expectations are kept.
- **New spec:** `apps/web/e2e/p3-inherited-approval.spec.ts` runs on the real stack in chromium-en and chromium-ar, at 1024, 1366, 1920 and 390 px. It checks that:
  - the badge lies inside its card or row and is not clipped;
  - the page doesn't scroll horizontally;
  - the other chips in the G1 card fit too;
  - G1 still shows the neutral "Not submitted" / "لم تُقدَّم" chip and nothing reads as approved;
  - axe finds no serious or critical issues.

**Checks (all exit 0):**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, prettier check, contrast check | all pass |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset and `C.UTF-8` | 1565/1565 in each |
| New spec | 10/10 (5 per language) |
| Full e2e suite, locale unset | 178 passed (the 168 baseline plus my 10), no failures or retries |
| Full e2e suite, `C.UTF-8` | 178 passed, no failures or retries |
| Reviewer's overflow probe, file unchanged, run from a scratch copy | 12/12 after the fix |
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG2` | PASS, at the start and at the end |

The handback has the counts for each spec.

**Before and after:**
- **Probe:** on the unmodified tree it reproduced the finding exactly (2/12, EN badge 518 px wide in a 335 px card). After the fix it gives 12/12.
- **Negative control:** I ran the new spec against the round-2 code and it failed as intended ("right edge 828 inside 634"), so it really detects the defect. I then restored my fix and rebuilt before running all the checks above.

**Disclosures:**
- In the "before" probe run the wrapper script exited 0 because of how I chained the commands. The probe itself reported exit 1, which was the expected reproduction.
- The reviewer's own harness scripts hard-code their own paths, so I ran the probe through the project's harness (`apps/web/e2e/support/with-stack.sh`) instead.
- I removed an empty `apps/web/.claude/.cc-writes` directory before running tests, as the assignment instructs.

**Known gap:** on the gate view the badge wraps within a narrow cell, so it takes three lines in English at 1366 and 1920 px. Making that row span the full width would need a CSS rule beyond the new class, which my scope doesn't allow, and the fix doesn't require it.

Screenshots are in `screens/en/` and `screens/ar/`, named `p3-inherited-{1024,1366,1920,390}-{gates-list,gate-view}.png`. The probe's after-fix screenshots are in `probe-after-screens/`.

Files are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG3/`:
- T-DG3-FE-G-frontend-ux-engineer.md
- T-DG3-FE-G-evidence/
